regime_context: The detector shows a defensive, crowded healthcare-led tape: Big Pharma is the eligible headline theme (durability 0.84, breadth 1.0, crowding z 1.46), with Health Care EW, Defensives, Staples EW and several other defensive themes all eligible and crowded. The absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps true), so trend discipline is meaningful for drawdown control even though cross-sectional momentum rank is only an attention lens.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the leadership remains concentrated in eligible healthcare/defensives or a confirmed handoff toward energy (US Energy Complex, eligible, trending, uncrowded) begins. Condition that retires this watch: XLE closes above PPH on a 10-day rolling relative-performance basis.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the top eligible theme by trend-health and cohesion: absolute-trend gate confirms an established up-trend, breadth is 1.0 (every constituent participating), and the highest durability bar (0.84) among leaders. This is a trend-continuation lean, not a momentum return forecast. Crowding z of 1.46 cautions sizing down but does not justify fading the confirmed leader.
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded and has already absorbed substantial attention; crowding_z 1.46 means the easy trade is crowded, and any macro re-acceleration into growth/AI could reverse the defensive leadership without warning.

falsifier.text: PPH breaks below its own 50-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW sits just behind Big Pharma in the same defensive healthcare complex: eligible, trend-confirmed, high durability (0.78) and broad participation (0.917). It offers a slightly less crowded expression of the same leadership, though crowding z 1.54 is still elevated so sizing should be modest.
theses.dissent: Healthcare leadership may be a late-cycle defensive bid that unwinds quickly if risk appetite returns; XLV is heavily exposed to managed care and pharma, both crowded and potentially vulnerable to policy headlines.

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by more than 5% over a rolling 20-day window

theses.subject: Defensives
theses.thesis: Defensives (Consumer Defensive) is eligible and trending with high durability (0.82) and 0.944 breadth — coherent defensive participation consistent with a broad risk-off rotation being led by healthcare and staples. This is a judgment call that the defensive complex holds, not a detector prediction.
evidence: crowded: true but within defensive complex
theses.dissent: The theme is unscorable via a single clean ETF proxy (XLP/XLU are mixed), and defensives are crowded; a sharp equity rally would leave this lagging badly.

falsifier.text: Consumer Defensive sectors lag the S&P 500 by 5% over the next 20 days

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
